rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name and zip, located the delivered order containing both robotic and canister vacuums, and selected the appropriate bagless canister variant from the same product line. However, it initiated the exchange without obtaining explicit confirmation after stating the exact change and refund method, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Additionally, the agent gave inconsistent information about refunding the price difference to a gift card—first saying it was possible, then saying it was not without an existing gift card—without performing any tool-supported change. Despite completing the exchange itself correctly, these policy violations mean the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
